title: review (other model, opus, security checklist): C-O5 fix round 1 on task/T-0173 — delta c1155c4..94d5e32 (T-0173, executed by claude:sonnet)
spec: Review ONLY the T-0173 delta: `git diff c1155c4 94d5e32` in worktree wt/T-0173 (Dockerfile, docker-compose.executor.yml, .dockerignore, docs/executor-host.md, .orchestrator/protected-paths.txt). Fix round for security review T-0171; confirm each item resolved: (1) protected-paths.txt names ~/orch-creds (no ${VAR}) plus the four container paths, runbook uses the same default and says how to protect another root; (2) compose joins an external network from ORCH_NET with a :? guard, ORCH_CREDS guarded, UID/GID defaulted, repos.toml and pool.toml mounted read-only from ./config, env_file required, no ports, no-new-privileges, cap_drop ALL, memory and pids limits; (3) runbook order: executor.env, ./work, ./config created and chowned before any compose run; network discovery; config edit + restart flow; target-repo pool.toml rule; (4) Dockerfile: FROM pinned by platform and digest with a bump comment, codex asset selected by dpkg architecture with checksum verification (or ARG CODEX_SHA256), installer scripts downloaded to files and hashed before execution, a comment stating what is verified vs only pinned; (5) .dockerignore excludes .git, .mcp*.json, pool_state.json, memory, tasks, scorecard, bench, *.lock, executor.env, config/ and uv sync --frozen still has what it needs. Do NOT run docker build (the Planner runs it as the external gate; its result is attached to the task before merge). Do run the objective secret grep over the diff and confirm it is clean. Apply the security checklist again to the changed lines. Verdict approve or request_changes with file:line comments; keep to real defects.
acceptance: Verdict approve or request_changes with file:line comments
Each of the five T-0171 groups confirmed resolved or named unresolved with evidence
Secret grep clean; security checklist applied to the changed lines

comments.issue: `.mcp*.json` excludes the four TRACKED role configs (.mcp.planner/review/scout/triage.json), not just the untracked local .mcp.json. In the image /opt/orchestrator has none, so install.py:156 (`orch_repo.glob('.mcp*.json')`) copies nothing into the cloned target repo, and goals.py:346 launches the Planner with `--mcp-config .mcp.planner.json --strict-mcp-config` against a file that does not exist. No preflight catches it, so every goal started in the container comes up with zero MCP servers — no bus, no orchestrator, no codex. Narrow the pattern to `/.mcp.json`.

`work/` is not excluded, but the same change makes ./work (compose:16, runbook step 2) the executor's clone root inside the build context (build.context: .). Any rebuild after the first goal — the runbook's own `up -d --build` — ships every cloned target repo, its .orchestrator/runs/*.log, bus.sqlite and .claude state into a `COPY . /opt/orchestrator` layer of an image that also carries live credential mounts. Add `work/` (and add `work/` and `config/` to .gitignore:10 — neither is ignored today).

`export GID` is a no-op: GID is not a bash variable (zsh/ksh only), so it exports an unset name, compose's `${GID:-1000}` falls back to 1000 and the container user's gid is 1000 regardless of `id -g` on line 25 — the exact misalignment step 1 exists to prevent. Line 41 degrades to `chown -R "$UID:"` for the same reason. `export GID=$(id -g)` fixes GID, but `UID=$(id -u)` is rejected (`bash: UID: readonly variable`, verified), so the step needs a compose `.env` file or different var names.

"From the host (or any container on the same docker network)" is wrong for the host half: no ports are published and Docker's embedded DNS serves containers only, so `curl http://orchestrator-executor:8090/healthz` from the host fails to resolve. Contradicts the file's own line 176-178.
"add `--platform linux/amd64` explicitly to `docker build`" is a no-op given Dockerfile:12 pins `FROM --platform=linux/amd64` — the two options offered are the same option.
Prerequisites name no minimum Compose version, but compose:12-14 uses the `env_file` long syntax (`path:`/`required:`), which needs Compose v2.24+; older plugins fail with an unhelpful schema error.
